text:
**Ready to Shape the Future of Logistics? Join Us as a Data Engineer!**

Are you passionate about turning messy data into smooth, world-changing decisions? We're looking for a talented Data Engineer to join our fast-growing logistics startup, where every pipeline you build helps get packages where they need to go, on time and on budget!

We've just closed our exciting Series A, raising an impressive $12M to supercharge our mission. As one of 60 passionate team members, you'll have the chance to make a real, visible impact from day one. No red tape, no waiting around. Just bold ideas and the autonomy to build them!

Our modern data stack is where the magic happens. You'll work with dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow to design scalable pipelines, sharpen data models, and empower teams across the company to act with confidence.

And the perks? We're proud to offer 4 days remote work each week, giving you the flexibility to do your best work while keeping the collaboration you love.

If you thrive on solving complex problems and want your work to move the world (literally!), we'd love to hear from you. Let's build the future of logistics together!
